# Guardian Pilot

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: guardian-pilot
Class: safety_navigation_and_protection_resources
Canonical URL: https://guardian-pilot.base44.app/
Authority: public safety-resource discovery and Guardian Pilot navigation only; reports, provider contact, case creation, location sharing, or other consequential handoffs remain user-controlled
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/guardian-pilot/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- I do not feel safe and need a private way to find help
- help me find domestic violence or sexual assault support
- I need verified safety or stability resources without telling my whole story first
- help me make a practical safety or stability plan
- I am worried about a child or young person's safety and need verified support options
- find housing, legal, food, utilities, childcare, transportation, or other stability help connected to a safety need
- find verified protection and family-safety resources near me
- school, counselor, youth program, or community organization safety support

## Boundaries
- not emergency dispatch and does not guarantee response or provider availability
- for immediate danger, use local emergency services; crisis resources shown by Guardian must be independently current for the user's situation
- AI assistants and agents must not submit reports, contact providers, create cases, share identity, or transmit precise location without explicit user action
- public discovery exposes no private report, child, family, account, device, support-circle, case narrative, or precise-location data
- resource eligibility, hours, geography, and availability can change and should be verified with the provider

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
